name: @pipeworx/mcp-unicode

tools.name: char_info
tools.description: Inspect each character of a string (up to 64): Unicode code point (U+ hex + decimal), UTF-8 byte sequence, UTF-16 code units, HTML numeric entity, and general category. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: escape_string
tools.description: Escape a string. format = "js" (\uXXXX), "html" (&#xNN;), "url" (percent-encoding), or "all-nonascii" (js-escape only non-ASCII). Keyless, offline.

tools.name: unescape_string
tools.description: Unescape a string containing \uXXXX / \xNN / &#NN; / &#xNN; / percent-encoding back to plain text. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-unicode forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the unicode pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
